evidence.title: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64

summary: The formally verified microkernel SeL4 has completed its security proofs for the 64-bit ARM (AArch64) platform, extending its guarantee of memory safety and isolation to a widely used processor family. This milestone broadens SeL4’s applicability in safety‑critical and secure systems ranging from aerospace to embedded devices.
title: SeL4 microkernel achieves full formal verification on AArch64 architecture
